section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Rear Axle Shaft
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Rear Axle Shaft

content.text: 10. INSTALL NEW OUTER BEARING AND NEW OUTER OIL SEAL

content.description: Cross-section diagram showing outer bearing installation with grease application points
Cross-section diagram showing oil seal installation with SST tool positioned 6.0mm from edge

items: (b) Using SST, drive in a new oil seal to a depth of 6.0 mm [0.236 in.].
(c) Apply MP grease No. 2 to lips of oil seal.

content.text: 1. INSTALL REAR AXLE SHAFT AND FLANGE

items: (a) Install the rear axle shaft into the housing.
(b) Install the flange with plate washer.

content.text: Before assembly, apply a thin coat of grease to the flange.

content.description: Exploded view showing rear axle shaft assembly with plate washer and flange components

items: (c) When installing the axle shaft and flange, use SST and tighten to the point where the flange and shaft deflector tip are aligned.

content.text: Do not allow grease to get on the shaft threads.

content.description: Installation diagram showing SST tool holding shaft while turning to tighten

items: (a) Install the new axle shaft flange nut.
(b) Using a bar to hold the shaft, tighten and torque the nut.

content.text: Check that the rear axle shaft has axial play.

content.description: Illustration showing use of bar to hold shaft while tightening nut
